title: India Leads the World in Jute and Ranks Second in Silk. Neither Fact Means What It Sounds Like.

version_history.note: New post: jute (world's top producer, captive JPM-Act market vs Bangladesh's export lead), silk (bivoltine/multivoltine grade gap despite rising output), wool (declining production, inbreeding quality gap despite large flock), and other natural fibres (banana, pineapple leaf, hemp - R&D stage)
